title: What Is Included in the Price of Your Package and What Is Charged Separately
content:
What the price of a package covers depends entirely on which of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products the package was booked under. Where a column below records that an item is included, it is covered by the package price; where it records a charge, that charge is raised separately at the figure shown.

## Board, drinks, gratuities, transfers and a tour manager

| Product | Main meals | Standard drinks | Resort or ship gratuities | Gratuities where not included, per traveller per day | Airport or port transfers | Return transfer where not included, per traveller | Tour manager throughout |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | charged separately | charged separately | charged separately | 0.00 USD | charged separately | 45.00 USD | not included |
| Flex Bundle Package | charged separately | charged separately | charged separately | 0.00 USD | included | 0.00 USD | not included |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | included | included | included | 0.00 USD | included | 0.00 USD | not included |
| Escorted Tour Package | included | charged separately | charged separately | 12.00 USD | included | 0.00 USD | included |
| Ocean Cruise Package | included | charged separately | charged separately | 18.50 USD | included | 0.00 USD | not included |
| Luxury Collection Package | included | included | included | 0.00 USD | included | 0.00 USD | included |

## Excursion credit, excursion discount, port charges and visa assistance

| Product | Excursion or resort credit per traveller | Credit must be spent within this many calendar days of departure | Discount on excursions booked in advance | Port charges and government taxes per traveller on a sailing | Visa assistance per traveller |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 0.00 USD | 0 | none, recorded as 0 per cent | 0.00 USD | 85.00 USD |
| Flex Bundle Package | 0.00 USD | 0 | 5 per cent | 0.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 75.00 USD | 7 | 10 per cent | 0.00 USD | 65.00 USD |
| Escorted Tour Package | 100.00 USD | 10 | 10 per cent | 0.00 USD | 55.00 USD |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 125.00 USD | 12 | 15 per cent | 189.00 USD | 65.00 USD |
| Luxury Collection Package | 350.00 USD | 14 | 20 per cent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

A credit figure of 0.00 USD, and a validity figure of 0 days beside it, record that the product grants no excursion or resort credit at all. A visa assistance figure of 0.00 USD records that the product makes no charge for that service.
